comment: The chaptered film: every shot is the real app (artifacts/video/scenes/<src>, 1440 px). Each chapter has narration, a title, timed bullets (cue = a word in the narration where the bullet appears) and clips. Clip fields: src, in (s), dur (s, the last clip fills the chapter), zoom [[t, cx, cy, side]] in source pixels (side 1440 = whole frame), callouts [{t0, t1, box [x0, y0, x1, y1], label}], note (an honest on-screen marker), audio [[file, at]] (diegetic sound).

chapters.title: AstraCAD Spatial
chapters.kicker: A CAD bench for Meta Quest
chapters.narration: AstraCAD Spatial is a CAD bench for Meta Quest. You design real parts with your hands and your voice, and every part is checked before you print it.
bullets: Design with your hands and your voice
Every part verified by exact formulas
Runs in the Quest Browser, on the headset

chapters.title: The bench, in your room
chapters.narration: It runs in the Quest browser, with nothing to install. The bench lands on your desk and anchors to the room, and a guide lights up the next step.
bullets: WebXR in the Quest Browser: no install, no account
Anchored to your room with WebXR anchors
A guide highlights each next step

chapters.title: Shape it with your hands
chapters.narration: Pinch an amber handle, and pull. The kernel rebuilds the part as you move. Then the truth gate checks it against an exact formula. Here they agree to better than one part in a billion. A part that fails is refused.
bullets: Pinch and pull: the solid rebuilds as you move
Truth gate: volume, size and holes checked against closed-form maths
Tolerance 0.001 %. A part that fails is never shown as verified

chapters.title: Or just say it
chapters.narration: Speech becomes text on the headset. A small language model, also on the headset, picks the part you mean, and the sizes come only from your words.
bullets: Whisper speech recognition, running on the headset
A small on-device language model picks the part
Sizes come only from what you said

clips.note: VOICE  ·  A RECORDED SENTENCE FED TO THE ON-DEVICE RECOGNISER (THE EMULATOR HAS NO MICROPHONE)

quotes: “I want a box to keep my Raspberry Pi in. 90 by 65 by 30.”

chapters.title: Measure the real thing
chapters.narration: Parts have to fit real things. Choose Measure, pinch both ends of the object, and hold still. The reading locks, and the part takes that size.
bullets: Pinch both ends with two hands, or span it with one
Hold still: the reading locks, with its spread
The size goes straight into the part

chapters.title: Draw it in the air
chapters.narration: No template for it? Draw the outline in the air. Let go, and it becomes a solid part, checked like every other.
bullets: Pinch and draw a closed outline above the bench
Let go: it is extruded into a solid

chapters.title: Test it with your hand
chapters.narration: Now test it. Push with your open palm, and the stress solver runs live: newtons, megapascals, and the safety factor. At a hundred and fourteen newtons, this bracket would yield.
bullets: Open-palm push: a live load, in newtons
Stress solver on the headset, cross-checked against CalculiX
Below a safety factor of 1, it turns red

chapters.title: Three engineers on the bench
chapters.narration: Three agents read every result: strength, printing, and cost. Pinch the structure agent's fix. The gusset grows, the part is rebuilt and re-tested, and the same push now holds.
bullets: Agents for structure, printing, and cost and standards
Each fix is one pinch: rebuilt, verified, re-tested
Gusset 14 to 32 mm: yields at 114 N, then holds 140 N

chapters.title: Lighter, and steady
chapters.narration: Grow bone strips away the material the load does not need: nineteen grams, down to thirteen. Vibration finds the natural frequencies, and shows each mode shape.
bullets: Grow bone: topology optimisation, 19.0 g to 13.4 g
Vibration: natural frequencies, solved on the headset
Each mode shape animated, slowed down

clips.note: VIBRATION SOLVE ON THIS PC: 14 S, NOT SHOWN

chapters.title: Real CAD underneath
chapters.narration: Underneath is real CAD: fillets, shells, sweeps and lofts, each checked against its own formula. A print-in-place hinge swings to its true limit.
bullets: Each proven by its own closed form: Pappus, the prismatoid
Print-in-place hinge: swings until its leaves touch

chapters.title: Take it with you
chapters.narration: When it is right, take it with you: a dimensioned drawing, an STL or 3MF for your slicer, a share code for your phone, or a co-design room another headset can join.
bullets: Share code and QR: opens on a phone
Co-design: a six-digit room, headset or phone

chapters.title: Made for everyone
chapters.narration: Captions, dwell to select, large text and one-handed use are built in. And on Meta's glasses, the layout fits the narrower view.
bullets: Captions, dwell select, large text, one-handed mode
Colour-safe stress colours and high contrast
Meta VR Glasses: a compact layout for the narrow view

chapters.title: AstraCAD Spatial
chapters.kicker: Measure the real thing. Get the part that fits.
chapters.narration: It works offline, with no account and no server. AstraCAD Spatial. Measure the real thing. Get the part that fits.
bullets: Works offline: no account, no server
